needs.text: Your thinnest positions: C (best: P 1012, 0.1 wins) · 1B (best: P 1006, 0.2 wins) · 2B (best: P 1001, 0.2 wins) · not known at RF

because.label: What it is
because.value: Your positions whose best player is expected to add the fewest wins for the rest of this season, from Pennant's projections. It says where your roster is thin, not who to sign: fit and role are yours to judge.

because.label: How it is read
because.value: Each position's best player by his expected wins for the rest of this season (the whole of it before it starts), most likely, from Player Value's production; the club's major-league position players by their listed position. A position whose players' production isn't established, or with nobody listed there, is named apart and never counted as zero.

because.label: RF
because.value: Nobody valued there

unknown: Nobody at RF has production established.
basis.stamp: The three positions whose best player is expected to add the fewest wins

because.label: Who is listed
because.value: Players no club holds, who last played in this league: free to sign today.

because.label: Order
because.value: Ordered by expected wins next season, most likely, most first; players whose production is not known come last.

because.label: Player
because.value: Every name opens his own window.

because.label: Age
because.value: His age as the export states it.

because.label: Scouted
because.value: Your scouts' grades for his tools, averaged on the rating scale: what he is now, and his ceiling. It's the organization's own view. It isn't the game's hidden rating of him, which weighs the tools by position and isn't something your front office can see. Where a tool hasn't been graded, the average is left blank rather than guessed.

because.label: 2040 wins
because.value: His projected wins above replacement (WAR) for the rest of 2040 (the whole of it before it starts), most likely, with the range it could be. It rests on his major-league record and his scouted tools, and on how much he has played.

because.label: 2041 wins
because.value: His projected wins above replacement (WAR) in 2041, most likely, with the range it could be. A player whose production can't be projected says why and sorts last.

because.label: 2041 at the market
because.value: What this league's market pays for a season of his expected play in 2041: the league minimum plus his projected wins × what a win costs here. Most likely, with the range it could be. It isn't his asking price or an offer, and it isn't what he's worth to your club: fit, need and budget are yours to weigh. Below the minimum means he is expected to play below a replacement-level player.

because.label: 2040 salary
because.value: What he's paid this season by his current club, as the export states it.

unknown: This export doesn't say which league a free agent last played in, so the players available now can't be listed.
